title: Facebook Ad Library Scraper - Competitor Ads & Creatives
description: Scrape ads from the public Facebook Ad Library. Extract ad creatives, text, headlines, spend ranges, impressions, targeting info, and more for any keyword, advertiser, or page ID.

keywords.title: Search Keywords
keywords.description: Search keywords to find ads in the Facebook Ad Library. Multiple keywords will be searched in sequence.

pageIds.title: Page IDs
pageIds.description: Facebook Page IDs to scrape ads for directly. Enter numeric Page IDs.

advertiserNames.title: Advertiser / Page Names
advertiserNames.description: Advertiser or Facebook Page names to search for in the Ad Library.

country.title: Country
country.description: Filter ads by country. Use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. US, GB, DE) or ALL for no filter.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Filter by platform where the ad is displayed.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of ads to scrape per search query. Set to 0 for unlimited (up to 1000).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for the crawler. Residential proxies recommended.
